profile_text.body:
Zebra Technologies Corp is a public company headquartered in Lincolnshire, Illinois, trading under the ticker ZBRA. On its website, Zebra describes itself as "The World's Foundation for Intelligent Operations" and says it powers intelligent operations to digitize, automate, and enhance processes with mobile computers, scanners, printers, RFID, and more. Its manufacturing technology solutions include hardware and software for automation, data analysis, and factory connectivity.

The company's site highlights AI software for frontline operations, naming Zebra Companion AI, Zebra Frontline AI Enablers, and Zebra Frontline AI Blueprints. It also offers the Zebra Aurora suite of machine vision software, with Zebra Aurora Focus described as an interface for controlling Fixed Industrial Scanners and Machine Vision Smart Cameras. Zebra describes its AI as an intelligent and open platform built to integrate with RFID, enterprise software, and machine vision.

The available facts list no litigation cases, but show 375 Illinois legal exposure records for the company. Zebra Technologies Corp is also listed under the alias ZEBRA TECHNOLOGIES CORP-CL A, with CIK 0000877212. No MCP servers or cataloged products are listed in the available facts.
